head_commit.message:
[ipa-delivery:837] Build the private RewindBox IPA 837: DeSmuME at 10x with the column compositor, and Azahar's tiled-GPU passes

Base 836 (run 45457017491, receipt 63bdad80). The libretro collection 14954690166 (run 45459585271
on 57b47ff2) replaces LibretroCores-e5378e84:
- desmume_libretro: 2D layers composed column by column for all the custom lines of a native line,
  partial sprite lines in SIMD, the 3D layer in NEON, the rasterizer's texture getters inline and
  its per-scanline state read once, desmume_rb_raster_cores, [rb-perf] l3d/lbg/lobj/engAd/engAn/
  runD/runN/rqos (docs/desmume-arm64-jit-architecture.md section 16.8);
- azahar_libretro: render passes for a tiled GPU (fceead82, 85a5528e, promoted at the maintainer's
  request).
Images that must change: azahar_libretro, desmume_libretro, Runner; 47 retained. Everything else,
the S2Arm engine 0351 included, is the 836's. MeloNX's 03394eb5 and 6c1accd8 are left to the 838.
Nothing measured on an iPhone.
